text: わしは　こうみえても　むかしは　いろんな　ばしょを　とびまわって　とびまわって！

structure.en: even though I look like this

structure.jp: いろんな　ばしょを
とびまわって　とびまわって！
structure.en: I flew about, and flew about, and...!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after a て-form means 'even though'. こうみえても = 'even though I look like this', a set way to say 'I may not look it, but'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form ties this action to what comes next, like 'and'. Here it is repeated and left hanging, so the story runs on into the next line. とびまわって　とびまわって = 'I flew about and flew about, and...'.
